catalogue.name: Mid-War - Eastern Front: German
catalogue.readme:
Overhauled 4-8-2025 (mostly housekeeping, formatting, etc as the base catalog was in pretty good shape. Big change was divorcing Fallschirmjager)

Haven't implemented Unit Cards for the most part; I'll be back at some point to do so but I wanna focus on getting catalogs up and running rather than fully finished.

sharedRules.name: Stormtroopers
sharedRules.description: A unit may attempt a second Movement Order after succeeding in its first Movement Order. The second Movement Order must be different from the first.

sharedRules.name: HEAT
sharedRules.description: A Team's Armour rating is not increased by +1 if it is more than 16"/40cm away when hit by HEAT weapons.

sharedRules.name: Escort Tanks
sharedRules.description: Ignore Bailed Out or Destroyed Escort tanks when determining if the Unit is In Good Spirits, so if there are no Bailed Out or Destroyed Tiger/Ferdinand tanks, the unit will be In Good Spritits.

sharedRules.name: Tiger Ace
sharedRules.description: Tiger Aces have a better Last Stand rating and a significantly better Remount rating.

sharedRules.name: Bazooka Skirts
sharedRules.description: A Tank Team with Bazooka Skirts increases its Side armour to 5 against weapons with Firepower 5+ or 6.

sharedRules.name: Flame Tank
sharedRules.description: Flame tanks cannont Charge Into Contact and have an Assault rating of 5+.

sharedRules.name: Mounted Assault
sharedRules.description: This Team has Assault 4+ and Counterattack 4+ with one Passanger and Assault 3+ and Counterattack 4+ with two  Passangers. This is shown on the Sd Kfz 251 Transport unit card as an additional motivation and skill column.

sharedRules.name: Unit Transport
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of the Transport Attachment must end the Movement Step within 6"/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on the table. If it cannot do this, then the Transport Attachment must be Sent to the Rear (see page 45 of the rulebook)

rules.name: Sniper's Hide
rules.description:
Sniper Teams are always Gone to Ground. 
Sniper Teams can be held in Ambush in addition to any other Teams permitted by the mission. If held in Reserve, they may still be placed from Ambush once they arrive on table. 
When placed from Ambush, Sniper Teams may be placed in their own Deployment Area or in No Man’s Land. 
Sniper Teams are ignored when determining whether or not the Formation is In Good Spirits.

rules.name: Unseen Killer
rules.description:
The target player cannot use the Mistaken Target rule if the Shooting Team is a Sniper Team. 
If an Infantry, Gun, or Unarmoured Tank Team is hit by a Sniper Team, its Unit is Pinned Down.

rules.name: Independent Infantry Team
rules.description: Unit cannot Charge into Contact or take an Objective, an is ignored for Victory Points.

rules.name: Demolitions Attachment
rules.description:
If the StuG Assault Gun Platoon is Destroyed or fails a Last Stand test, the Demolitions Attachment is removed from the game, but is not Destroyed. 

The Borgward demolition carriers of a Demolitions Attachment cannot Charge into Contact (unless a StuG Takes Control) and must Break Off if Assaulted. They cannot take or hold Objectives, and are ignored for Formation Last Stand tests and when determining Victory Points. 

The Danger Close rule does not apply to friendly Artillery Bombardments which can fire as close as they like to Borgward carriers.

rules.name: Explosives
rules.description:
A Borgward demolition carrier can only make an attack with its Demolitions when a StuG control tank Takes Control of it. 
The Demolitions Artillery Bombardment is automatically Ranged In and automatically Hits all Teams under the Template. Remove the Borgward carrier from play after resolving this Bombardment. 
The Bombardment also automatically removes any Minefield tokens under the Template. 
If a Borgward demolition carrier is Destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a die. On a roll of 1 or 2, it immediately attacks with its Demolitions weapon.

rules.name: Control Tank
rules.description:
In the Assault Step, instead of Assaulting, a StuG that has not Moved or Shot this turn, may Take Control of a Borgward carrier from its Demolition Attachment that is within 20"/50cm and in Line of Sight.

When it does so, the Borgward carrier may move up to 4"/10cm as if it was Charging into Contact while launching an  Assault, or remain in place. The enemy then conduct Defensive Fire (whether or not the Borgward carrier moved). The Borgward carrier ignores Bailed Out results. 

If the Borgward carrier is not Destroyed, it then attacks with its Demolitions weapon.
